answer: Proof of Stake serves as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism, requiring agents to bond collateral to participate in consensus. An attacker attempting to scale fake identities faces the prohibitive cost of acquiring enough assets to dilute the network, a barrier akin to traversing a harsh juniper thicket at dawn. Every malicious whisper of vote manipulation is mitigated because the cost to validate exceeds potential gains, ensuring that economic gravity anchors identity to tangible capital rather than ephemeral code.
